source.representation_note: OCCT frozen BREP compound containing one two-face shell; operation extracts that same shell. SMLib imports equivalent finite rational NURBS geometry, with distinct native representation.

method: Read-only independent OCP BREP/STEP readback, NumPy finite native-edge circle fits and D2 curvature reduction. No fillet calls, repair, model edits or mesh-as-geometry proof.
